description: A creeper at night swells next to a client player, explodes and kills it (#211): the whole death path of ServerPlayer.die runs from the explosion damage applied after the creeper's tick: drops of inventory and armour with the player's random, the XP orbs, the death statistics (deaths, killed_by creeper via the kill credit) and entity_killed_player of the data pack. All chunks in the player's simulation distance are forced (no asynchronous loads in Vanilla), and spawn_monsters is off (no phantom spawner draws).
